title: Stop launched.json ordering from failing parallel branches
problem: launched.json has a byte-for-byte sort test, and parallel branches each append an entry, so main needs repair commits after merges.
change: Have the check normalise (or `launched.mjs --write` run in regen) instead of failing on order alone; keep failing on missing dates.
result: mechanism holds: `node --test platform/pages/launched.test.mjs` passes 23/0 on b5b9aaf3c0. Repair-commit rate cannot be measured yet: the baseline is one day (2026-10-14) and the clone has no later day to compare.
